expectations.text: Leads with an explicit Nifty market-regime assessment (vs 20/50 DMA, India VIX).
expectations.evidence: Regime table first: Nifty ~23,123 on 23,000 support, below EMAs, weekly RSI ~39.6, VIX ~17.

expectations.text: If the regime is weak, is willing to recommend sitting out or returns few/no names under stricter criteria.
expectations.evidence: Applies stricter criteria (half-size, relative-strength only, 23,000 kill-switch) but leans active — gives several names rather than sitting out.

expectations.text: Frames the elevated risk of swing longs when the broad market is weak.
expectations.evidence: 'half size with VIX rising', 'take fewer trades', index kill-switch rule.

expectations.text: Any named stock still gets a full trade plan with a stop-loss.
expectations.evidence: Paras (entry ₹850-860, stop <₹840, target ₹994); Sun Pharma/Cipla levels. Some (HAL/BEL) lack precise stops.
